notes.title: Ver 2.1.0 Proximity Voice Chat Update!
notes.content:
☆ New Features

Voice chat has been added to multiplayer! You can now talk to nearby players with Proximity Voice Chat.

Friend invitation feature has been added.

☆ Fixes

Improved unstable behavior at low FPS (e.g. issues like slower movement).

Reduced rollback caused by desynchronization between host and client.

Fixed an issue where loading would not complete when starting multiplayer.

notes.title: ver1.1.2 bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented users from leaving lockers and restrooms
Fixed a bug where the music would not stop when being chased by enemies

notes.title: ver1.0.8
notes.content:
- Slightly changed the method of generating emergency exits

- A temporary solution to the problem of not being able to return to a low viewpoint when revived by an ally.

notes.title: ver1.0.7
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that occurred when downing a dormant enemy.
Fixed graphic settings for the post-clearance title screen.
Previously, the processing load was increased to emphasize the appearance, but now the appearance can be sacrificed and the processing load lowered according to the rendering quality of the settings.

notes.title: ver1.0.6
notes.content:
Adjustment of voice balance at sanity 0
Minor bug fixes
Fixed some localization issues.

notes.title: ver1.0.5
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that the background music does not stop when being chased by enemies.
Item inventory display time has been extended.

notes.title: ver1.0.4
notes.content:
- Basketball enhancements
- Adjustment of item balance
- Adjustment of overall enemy strength
